notes.title: Small Map Fix and Content Update
notes.content:
Update:


 The Garage map has been slightly updated.


New:

 A new note has been added to the Garage, triggered by a new horror event.

notes.title: Critical Build Error Fix
notes.content:
Update:

Build Size


 Old: 4.08 GB
 New: 3.93 GB


Change in Save Game Directory

Old Save Directory: Located in the game folder

 File path: steamapps\common\Escape The Garage\EscapeTheGarage\Saved\SaveGames

New Save Directory: Located in the user folder 

 File path: AppData\Local\EscapeTheGarage\Saved\SaveGames


Build Integration Error Fixed

notes.title: Content Update 2
notes.content:
Update:


 Note 1 and Note 3 for the door code have been changed slightly.
 Small bugs have been fixed.


New:

 A lighter has been added and can be found in the garage.
 More candles have been added that can be lit with the new lighter.
 A line of text was added that the player character says upon a single incorrect entry of the door code.
A new achievement has been added.

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Update:

New:

 conversation with the stalker has been completely revised.
 Another camera was installed in the garage.
 A surveillance monitor as well as a remote control and 4 VHS players were installed in the secret passage.

notes.title: Update 01
notes.content:
Update:

[olist]
 Change of keycard locations: All keycards have new locations (Some keycards are easier to find).

 First hint: The note for the code has received a new diary entry.
[/olist]

notes.title: Escape The Garage is now available
notes.content:
Welcome to Escape The Garage, the thrilling escape game that will send chills down your spine. Immerse yourself in a slightly rough and creepy atmosphere that will captivate you from the first minute.

You wake up at an abandoned train station. No one is in sight, and the silence is eerie. Your goal: to get to your car and drive home. But as you reach your car, a mysterious figure stands there. Before you know it, you are kidnapped and find yourself in a dark garage.

Now your nightmare begins: you must find a way to escape from the garage. Solve puzzles, find clues, and uncover secrets while the eerie feeling never leaves your side.

Escape The Garage offers you three different endings to discover: one main ending and two secret endings. Each of your decisions influences the outcome of your adventure and presents you with unique challenges and revelations.

Are you ready to face your worst nightmare and find the way to freedom? Or will you remain trapped in the darkness of the garage forever?

Key Features:

Creepy and suspenseful atmosphere
Challenging puzzles and secrets
Three different endings to discover
Captivating story with surprising twists
Experience the game anew even after completing it with the exciting New Game Plus mode

Take on the challenge and find a way out in Escape The Garage. Will you escape?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124670/Escape_The_Garage/
